title: Corpse Lake
physical_identity: A manmade lake of radioactive, blood-draining crimson liquid made from melted Object 24 masks, ringed by an M.E.G. barbed-wire Exclusion Zone.
scale_topology: Single outdoor lake inside Level 10, ~40 km from Malt Town; grown to 0.8 cubic miles; fenced exclusion zone; no vertical structure.
anomalies: ultraviolet veins and central black area
victims release new substance after death
lighting_sound: Not stated for ambience; liquid appears murky crimson; substance emits inaudible ~30 PHz sound; audio credits include Geiger counter.
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE (only the substance itself)

entrances.method: walk to the lake from Malt Town
entrances.quote: Despite being an easily accessible location

exits.quote: all who have previously entered have never been heard from afterwards

signature_mechanic: Entering the Exclusion Zone starts an irreversible exposure clock; contact with the liquid ends the run.
do_not: move Malt Town to the lake
make hidden level a safe exit
conflicts_notes: No Entrances/Exits heading. Casualty table says no victims since 12 Aug 2021 vs page edited later. 'One notable exception' radiation outside zone is not in captured text. /level-924 link targets the 'undocumented level'.

key_quotes.quote: Standing adjacent to Corpse Lake for more than an hour is fatal.
spells guaranteed death within the next hour
grass and other plants can freely grow on the banks of the lake
all who have previously entered have never been heard from afterwards
